title: koda Architecture Ratchet Allowlist
description: Baseline exception list for koda-owned domain architecture boundaries and state ratchets. Upstream-owned shared opencode files are exempt to prevent upstream merge conflicts. As koda legacy sites are refactored into clean Effect layers, decrement counts or remove entries to lock in progress.

koda-instance-state-singletons.description: Legacy InstanceState.make usages in koda-owned code (packages/opencode/src/koda/**, packages/opencode/src/koda-*/**). Target: encapsulate in scoped Effect Services in packages/core.

koda-database-constructors.description: Direct new Database() / new DatabaseSync() instantiations in koda-owned code. Target: all persistence routes through core Database.Service.

koda-tool-process-env.description: Direct process.env reads in koda-owned tools. Target: pass configuration explicitly via Tool.Context or Env.Service.
